title: Inherited CETP deficiency (1989)
note: A CETP splice-site mutation caused inherited CETP deficiency and markedly increased HDL. This establishes human genetic effects on the biomarker, not protection from coronary disease.

title: CETP suppression in rabbits (1998)
note: Target-level preclinical evidence: CETP antisense treatment reduced atherosclerotic lesions in cholesterol-fed rabbits. This was not a torcetrapib experiment.

title: CETP inhibitor in rabbits (2000)
note: A different CETP inhibitor, JTT-705, improved lipids and attenuated rabbit atherosclerosis. It supports the target class, not torcetrapib-specific safety or efficacy.

title: Torcetrapib Phase 1 study (2004)
note: Early human proof of mechanism: torcetrapib increased HDL over 14 days. Publication date is shown; the study began earlier, but no verified start date is asserted here.

title: ILLUMINATE registry
location: protocolSection identification, status, design and eligibility
note: Phase 3 torcetrapib/atorvastatin versus atorvastatin. Population includes coronary heart disease or high-risk diabetes; broader than the exact CAD GWAS population.

title: Pfizer programme stop (2006)
note: Sponsor stopped trials and compound development after the mortality/cardiovascular-event imbalance.

title: ILLUMINATE results (2007)
location: Abstract and discussion; published online 2007-11-05; PMID 17984165
note: Torcetrapib increased HDL but increased mortality and cardiovascular morbidity. This does not isolate CETP inhibition as the cause of harm.

title: CETP genetics versus torcetrapib (2009 online)
note: Genetic lipid effects resembled treatment; blood-pressure effects did not. Supports an off-target interpretation of the hypertensive effect, not proof of every cause of death.

title: HDL cholesterol and heart attack MR (2012)
note: Some genetic mechanisms raising HDL did not lower myocardial-infarction risk. HDL-level evidence is not a CETP-specific verdict; MI is related to, but not identical to, the CAD dataset outcome.

title: ACCELERATE registry
location: protocolSection identification, status, design and eligibility
note: Phase 3, terminated for insufficient efficacy. High-risk vascular population and composite endpoint, not an exact reproduction of the CAD GWAS.

title: Lilly programme stop (2015)
note: Development for high-risk ASCVD discontinued due to insufficient efficacy; the stated stop was not for safety findings.

title: ACCELERATE results (2017)
location: Abstract and trial results; 2017-05 (month precision); PMID 28514624
note: Favorable lipid changes did not translate into fewer cardiovascular events in this trial.

title: CETP/HMGCR genetic analysis (2017)
note: Cardiovascular associations tracked apoB reduction in the joint genetic analysis. Do not reduce CETP effects to HDL elevation alone.

title: REVEAL anacetrapib results (2017)
note: Anacetrapib reduced major coronary events in REVEAL. Necessary counterexample to a claim that all CETP inhibition fails.

title: Obicetrapib PREVAIL registry
location: protocolSection status and design; source update 2024-06-04
note: Retrieved Phase 3 ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING record. Old registry update, not proof of current recruitment or programme-wide regulatory status.
